text_en: So Abram went up from Egypt, he and his wife, and all that he had, and Lot with him, into the Negeb.
text_cn: 亚巴郎带了妻子和他所有的一切，与罗特一同由埃及上来，往乃革布去。

text_en: Now Abram was very rich in livestock, in silver, and in gold.
text_cn: 亚巴郎有许多牲畜和金银。

text_en: He journeyed on by stages from the Negeb as far as Bethel, to the place where his tent had been at the beginning, between Bethel and Ai,
text_cn: 他由乃革布逐渐往贝特耳移动帐幕，到了先前他在贝特耳与哈依之间，支搭帐幕的地方，

text_en: to the place where he had made an altar at the first; and there Abram called on the name of the Lord .
text_cn: 亦即他先前筑了祭坛，呼求上主之名的地方。

text_en: Now Lot, who went with Abram, also had flocks and herds and tents,
text_cn: 与亚巴郎同行的罗特，也有羊群、牛群和帐幕，

text_en: so that the land could not support both of them living together; for their possessions were so great that they could not live together,
text_cn: 那地方容不下他们住在一起，因为他们的产业太多，无法住在一起。

text_en: and there was strife between the herders of Abram’s livestock and the herders of Lot’s livestock. At that time the Canaanites and the Perizzites lived in the land.
text_cn: 牧放亚巴郎牲畜的人与牧放罗特牲畜的人，时常发生口角，──当时客纳罕人和培黎齐人尚住在那里。

text_en: Then Abram said to Lot, “Let there be no strife between you and me, and between your herders and my herders; for we are kindred.
text_cn: 亚巴郎遂对罗特说：“在我与你，我的牧人与你的牧人之间，请不要发生口角，因为我们是至亲。

text_en: Is not the whole land before you? Separate yourself from me. If you take the left hand, then I will go to the right; or if you take the right hand, then I will go to the left. ”
text_cn: 所有的地方不是都在你面前吗？请你与我分开。你若往左，我就往右；你若往右，我就往左。”

text_en: Lot looked about him, and saw that the plain of the Jordan was well watered everywhere like the garden of the Lord , like the land of Egypt, in the direction of Zoar; this was before the Lord had destroyed Sodom and Gomorrah.
text_cn: 罗特举目看见约但河整个平原，直到左哈尔一带全有水灌溉，──这是在上主消灭索多玛和哈摩辣以前的事，──有如上主的乐园，有如埃及地。

text_en: So Lot chose for himself all the plain of the Jordan, and Lot journeyed eastward; thus they separated from each other.
text_cn: 罗特选了约但河的整个平原，遂向东方迁移；这样，他们就彼此分开了：

text_en: Abram settled in the land of Canaan, while Lot settled among the cities of the Plain and moved his tent as far as Sodom.
text_cn: 亚巴郎住在客纳罕地；罗特住在平原的城市中，渐渐移动帐幕，直到索多玛。

text_en: Now the people of Sodom were wicked, great sinners against the Lord .
text_cn: 索多玛人在上主面前罪大恶极。

text_en: The Lord said to Abram, after Lot had separated from him, “Raise your eyes now, and look from the place where you are, northward and southward and eastward and westward;
text_cn: 罗特与亚巴郎分离以后，上主对亚巴郎说：“请你举起眼来，由你所在的地方，向东西南北观看；

text_en: for all the land that you see I will give to you and to your offspring forever.
text_cn: 凡你看见的地方，我都要永远赐给你和你的后裔。

text_en: I will make your offspring like the dust of the earth; so that if one can count the dust of the earth, your offspring also can be counted.
text_cn: 我要使你的后裔有如地上的灰尘；如果人能数清地上的灰尘，也能数清你的后裔。

text_en: Rise up, walk through the length and the breadth of the land, for I will give it to you. ”
text_cn: 你起来，纵横走遍这地，因为我要将这地赐给你。”

text_en: So Abram moved his tent, and came and settled by the oaks of Mamre, which are at Hebron; and there he built an altar to the Lord .
text_cn: 于是亚巴郎移动了帐幕，来到赫贝龙的玛默勒橡树区居住，在那里给上主筑了一座祭坛。
